proposed_from.topic: Sharp disconnected Hall prediction sets for ordinal individual treatment effects. Fix L>=3 and two randomized arms with Y(d) in {0,...,L-1}; the marginals mu0,mu1 are identified and their coupling is unrestricted. For every effect set S define worst-coupling coverage h_mu(S), and define the deterministic shortest valid set by cardinality, span, then binary code. Prove the exact Hall/rectangle representation, characterize all shortest sets, give necessary-and-sufficient disconnectedness inequalities and the complete L=3 frontier, derive sharp general-L bounds comparing shortest arbitrary sets with shortest intervals, and compute them by an explicit min-cut plus finite outer optimization. Use simultaneous multinomial confidence-polytopes to certify every reported set uniformly, with selection consistency on the stated fixed-margin class. Consumer: the seven-category endpoint in Goldman et al.'s remdesivir 5-versus-10-day trial. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Exact derivation gives h(S)=max(0,max_{A-B subset S}[mu1(A)+mu0(B)-1]), so every cardinality minimizer is a threshold-feasible difference set A-B. The presolve derived a complete L=3 frontier and sharp bounds I*/k* <= (2L-1)/3 and I*-k* <= 2L-4, attained by strictly positive endpoint-heavy marginals for every 0<alpha<1/2. The accepted witness has exact coverage 39/50; 43,560 rational L=3 cases and 120 independent transport comparisons passed. An invalid robust min/max interchange was found and removed; Hall duality is supporting prior art, not the headline. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Independently verify the all-minimizer rectangle normal form at boundary marginal laws and the exhaustive L=3 support-pattern classification; numerical checks do not prove the universal statements. EARLY KILL TEST: Compare transport LPs with rectangle selection for every effect set on bounded L=3 and L=4 rational grids, including zero cells and threshold equalities, and verify the endpoint-heavy extremizers; any mismatch stops or pivots the run. seed_details.anchor: ZhangRichardson2025, Appendix D and the ordinal discussion following Theorem 16
seed_details.opportunity: Determine the exact worst-case price of forcing a coupling-robust ordinal individual-effect prediction set to be an interval rather than an arbitrary subset.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the interval endpoint search of Zhang and Richardson by a Hall-certificate search over difference sets, then prove a compression inequality from an arbitrary feasible rectangle to an interval.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for ordinal individual-treatment-effect prediction sets, disconnected robust supports, Hall shortest sets, and interval-versus-arbitrary coupling coverage found no theorem giving the proposed constants.

method_exemplars: GaoShanSrinivasVijayaraghavan2025, Theorem 3 and its extremal structured-set comparison

seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that the ratio follows immediately by taking the interval hull of any optimal set.
seed_details.rebuttal: The hull bound depends on the additive-combinatorial constraint that every optimal set contains a threshold-feasible difference set; the cases of one, two, and at least three differences yield different sharp bounds, and strictly positive marginal laws are required for attainment.

seed_details.opportunity: Give a mutually exclusive and exhaustive marginal-inequality frontier for when the deterministic shortest robust set is disconnected at the first nonbinary support size.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The binary exclusion of the only disconnected candidate must be replaced by an exhaustive classification of ternary difference patterns and their active Hall rectangles.
seed_details.destination_search: The ordinal-benefit papers of Lu, Ding, and Dasgupta and the discrete-programming paper of Duarte and coauthors treat scalar events or generic bounds, not the selected multi-effect support.

exemplars_used.writing_exemplar: ZhangRichardson2025, Introduction, Remark 5, and Appendix D
method_exemplars: LuDingDasgupta2018, Propositions 1 and 2 and their triangular transport constructions
DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024, exact finite enumeration followed by symbolic certification

seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that five effect values permit brute-force enumeration and therefore no theorem is needed.
seed_details.rebuttal: Enumeration only proposes cells; the contribution is a boundary-safe symbolic partition covering zero masses, exact coverage equalities, and all objective ties, with necessary and sufficient inequalities.

seed_details.anchor: MalloyTripathyNowak2021, Theorem 1 and the level-set inversion construction
seed_details.opportunity: Invert simultaneous multinomial regions through worst-coupling coverage so that post-selection certification is finite-sample valid and the lexicographic selector is uniformly consistent off tie surfaces.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace scalar linear-functional projection of a multinomial region by a joint transportation program that preserves the order \(\min_{\nu}\max_A\) and certifies all selected sets simultaneously.
seed_details.destination_search: Huang and coauthors cover a scalar ordinal benefit bound, while Fang and Santos treat directionally differentiable maps; neither result recovers a discrete set-valued optimizer under cardinality, span, and code ties.

method_exemplars: HuangFangHanleyRosenblum2019, constrained stochastic optimization at polyhedral boundaries
FangSantos2019, directional analysis with all active maximizers

seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that confidence-region projection makes validity automatic.
seed_details.rebuttal: Validity is the easy half; the nontrivial requirements are an exact finite program that avoids an invalid robust min--max interchange and a uniform selector theorem with an explicit separation class.

seed_details.opportunity: Characterize every cardinality-minimal robust effect set as a threshold-feasible difference set, including simplex faces and binding Hall equalities.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Apply Strassen deficiency to the complement of the allowed-effect relation and identify the complement of each Hall neighborhood as the second side of a rectangle.
seed_details.destination_search: The exact fixed-support Hall theorem is occupied, but the optimizer-wide difference-set corollary is not stated in the searched ordinal ITE literature.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that this is an immediate corollary of finite Strassen deficiency.
seed_details.rebuttal: That objection limits the result to a supporting lemma; it remains essential infrastructure but is not presented as the headline contribution.

seed_details.anchor: GaoShanSrinivasVijayaraghavan2025, Theorem 3 and the structured-volume comparison
seed_details.opportunity: Classify every marginal law attaining the sharp interval-price constants rather than merely construct one extremal family.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the extremal-instance construction by inverse additive combinatorics for equality in \(|A-B|\geq |A|+|B|-1\) together with equality in every Hall compression step.
seed_details.destination_search: No causal or structured-prediction source located characterizes equality under adversarial potential-outcome coupling.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that equality follows from standard inverse sumset theory.
seed_details.rebuttal: Inverse sumset structure controls only support geometry; the marginal mass inequalities and robust-coupling feasibility add independent equality restrictions.

seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the exact marginal surfaces on which uniform recovery of the deterministic shortest-set selector is impossible.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Move from directional differentiability of a real-valued maximum to local asymptotic indistinguishability of two categorical laws whose discrete selectors differ.
seed_details.destination_search: The searched nonregular-inference sources establish bootstrap failure or scalar-bound inference, not an exact impossibility region for this selector.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that discontinuity trivially rules out uniform consistency.
seed_details.rebuttal: Discontinuity alone does not identify the maximal regular region or yield the two-point lower bound at each feasibility and tie-break surface.

seed_details.opportunity: Derive the sharp robust-coupling price of restricting the effect set to a union of at most \(r\) intervals for every \(r\).
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace one-interval hull compression by an \(r\)-component covering theorem for integer difference sets.
seed_details.destination_search: Structured conformal work optimizes unions of intervals under an observed response law, not under the infimum over fixed-marginal couplings.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that the result is a routine interpolation between arbitrary sets and intervals.
seed_details.rebuttal: The number of connected components of a difference set is controlled by additive structure rather than cardinality alone, so no routine interpolation was found; feasibility is nevertheless too uncertain for the first version.

seed_details.anchor: ZhangRichardson2025, Section on prediction intervals with covariates
seed_details.opportunity: Construct shortest disconnected prediction sets conditional on covariates with uniform coupling-robust coverage.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The finite marginal vectors become nuisance functions of covariates, so every Hall mass inequality must be estimated uniformly before discrete selection.
seed_details.destination_search: Conditional Makarov inference is adjacent, but the exact target requires a separate function-class and smoothing theory not supplied by the present fixed-support substrate.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that this merely applies the population theorem pointwise in covariates.
seed_details.rebuttal: Uniform estimation and selection across covariates are not pointwise corollaries, but the needed smoothness layer would obscure the sharper fixed-margin structural result.
